pkgmetadata.longdescription: Orca runs a fleet of coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and others) in parallel, each in its own git worktree, and tracks their terminals, diffs and sessions in one place. The desktop app runs on dev-util/electron-bin. The server, orcad, runs on Node.js without any desktop library, keeps the projects, terminals and agents of a user running, and serves the desktop app, the web client and the mobile app of other computers. The command is orca-ide, as /usr/bin/orca belongs to the GNOME screen reader.

use.flag: Install the desktop app, which runs on dev-util/electron-bin
Install the server alone (orcad on Node.js, without Electron) with an OpenRC service and a systemd unit per user
Build the helper that the desktop app uses for the clipboard on native Wayland sessions
